An open-source early-reading app built by a parent for their 6-year-old: she had moved through basic phonics with Teach Your Monster to Read but found it repetitive, and needed stories to read while still getting help sounding words out. The app gives her real reading material with phonics support on tap - the experience of sitting and reading a book, with backup when a word won't yield.
